description:
§24.5: an HTML breakout start tag as a child of SVG or MathML content is E-HTML-FOREIGN-BREAKOUT. The HTML parser ends the foreign content at the tag and builds it outside the

in

in ; one report each.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S474 "⭐ RULED — FORK RULE row C amended: semantic impossibility may be PERMANENT" (the PERMANENT class); the code and its reading are a PA reading in the S474 review of #1727 (F1–F3, reproduced in Chromium)
rationale: §24.5 item 1: an HTML breakout start tag written as a child of an SVG element (other than foreignObject / desc / title) or of a MathML element (other than mi / mo / mn / ms / mtext / an HTML-encoded annotation-xml) SHALL be E-HTML-FOREIGN-BREAKOUT, gated or not.
